primary.title: How I Run a 20+ Agent AI Company for $1,337/Month
primary.subject: Avem Investment GmbH
constraints: Reliable enough to run unattended overnight

architecture.infrastructure: Single Hetzner VPS (4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, $8/month). OpenClaw/Moltbot gateway inside Docker. Custom Next.js dashboard (22 pages, Supabase backend) with real-time visibility into every agent, cost, and workflow.
agent_domains: C-Suite Swarm (CMO, CDO, COO, CSO, CTO, CPO, CRO) — daily strategy reports, market analysis, risk assessment
Content Pipeline (Generator, Enricher, Scout, Autopsy Analyst) — newsletter drafts, social posts, video scripts
Dev-Bridge (Task Picker, Code Agent, Pre-Flight, PR Builder) — autonomous development with quality gates
Voice Bridge (Call Handler, Calendar Agent, Booking Agent) — inbound voice calls, scheduling, callbacks
Operations (Retention Agent, Heartbeat Monitor, Cost Tracker, Notification Router) — GDPR cleanup, system health
architecture.multi_model_routing: MiniMax M2.7 (45%, default + standups), Kimi K2.6 (30%, swarm sub-agents), GLM 5.1 (15%, fact-checking), Haiku/Sonnet/Opus (10%, fallback). Saves 40-60% vs single premium model.
architecture.integrations: 5 Make.com scenarios connecting Beehiiv, Typefully, HeyGen, YouTube, Twilio/ElevenLabs. Cal.com for scheduling, Stripe for payments.

key_learnings: Multi-model routing is the single biggest cost lever. Running everything on Opus or GPT-4 would cost 3-5× more.
Every feature needs a kill switch. 'Turn it off' must be a 1-second operation, not a deployment.
You need a dashboard, not just logs. Logs tell you what happened. A dashboard tells you what is happening.
Define automation boundaries explicitly. Voice + calendar: 90% automated. Community engagement: 0%, intentionally.
JSON output from LLMs is fragile. Defensive extraction + schema validation are mandatory.
Your knowledge base needs two layers, not one. SQL for quantitative (no hallucinated numbers), Markdown/RAG for qualitative context.
results_since_january_2026: Daily operations: 7 C-Suite agents produce strategy reports every weekday morning
Content pipeline: automated newsletter drafts, social posts, AI-generated video with human approval gates
Autonomous development: Dev-Bridge picks tasks, writes code, runs pre-flight checks, opens PRs
Voice automation: inbound calls handled by AI with ElevenLabs synthesis, calendar integration, callback tracking
Compliance: GDPR-compliant data retention with automated cleanup, documented deletion procedures
